issue_context.title: boards: riscv: ite: No flash and RAM stats are shown whenever building ITE board
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
No flash and RAM stats are shown whenever building ITE board

it8xxx2_evb

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. cd samples/helloworld
2. rm -rf build && west build -c -b it8xxx2_evb
3.  No flash and RAM stats are shown.

**Expected behavior**
Flash and RAM stats should be shown to support footprint assessments

**Impact**
This prevent RAM and code footprint assessments, planning and optimizations.

**Logs and console output**
-- west build: building application
[1/150] Preparing syscall dependency handling
[3/150] Generating include/generated/version.h
-- Zephyr version: 3.2.0-rc1 (/home/jamezaar/ecwork/zephyr_albertofloyd), build: zephyr-v3.1.0-5147-g7c50ab1f0364

[144/150] Linking C executable zephyr/zephyr_pre1.elf
[150/150] Linking C executable zephyr/zephyr.elf

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
Linux
